recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It finishes the approved FHIR-15782 wording without reopening later RequestStatus hierarchy work or future-code proposals.
issue_request: FHIR-15782 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and asked to update valueset-request-status definitions. The final resolution rejected adding 'plan' everywhere, but approved specific wording changes, including defining on-hold as a request and any implicit authorization that has been temporarily paused and is expected to resume.
initial_application: Jira records Github#6b8ca9c6. That merge applied most FHIR-15782 definition changes in source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml, but committed on-hold as 'temporarily withdrawn' rather than the approved 'temporarily paused'. The 2021 source rework carried that wording into source/request/codesystem-request-status.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists request as an active logical pattern, and the request-status worksheet plus CodeSystem source feed the current Request pattern terminology. Related Published/Applied decisions renamed suspended/cancelled to on-hold/revoked, aligned Request.status usage, and added the ended parent status, but none supersede the FHIR-15782 on-hold definition. FHIR-53252 remains Resolved - change required and outside this default Applied/Published source-edit scope.
reconciliation: Changed source/request/codesystem-request-status.xml and source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml so on-hold now says the request has been temporarily paused. No change was needed in source/request/valueset-request-status.xml because it only composes the request-status CodeSystem.
source_changes: source/request/codesystem-request-status.xml: changed the on-hold definition from temporarily withdrawn to temporarily paused.
source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml: changed the request-status worksheet on-hold definition to the same approved paused wording.

related_jiras.note: Published Request/Event status rename from suspended/cancelled to on-hold/revoked explains the code names used by the current artifact.
Published cleanup aligning request resources with on-hold/revoked confirms the current RequestStatus vocabulary, but did not supersede the on-hold definition.
Published Request pattern alignment issue confirms Request.status should use request-status with on-hold/revoked names.
Applied R6 change added the ended parent status under the same CodeSystem but left the on-hold definition untouched.
Resolved - change required future RequestStatus proposal is outside this run's source-edit scope and does not alter the FHIR-15782 wording decision.
